units.source_text: “是呵，别人的事，也许还是别管他的好……”

en.t: Yes, maybe it is better not to meddle in other people's affairs after all...

units.source_text: 他调整了一下姿势，激动地说，“可是，这种搞鬼的买卖，一定有人赚了许多吧？

en.t: He shifted his posture slightly and said excitedly, "But with a shady business like this, someone must have made a lot of money, right?
...even if you are not trying to shield those people..."
